notes: VLM GROUNDING eval — does ground_box() put the circle on the right thing, or correctly abstain (NOT FOUND)? This is the layer no other eval covers (tools.json grades the 1B's tool CHOICE; find.json grades retrieval; this grades the VLM box). Cases are hand-built from the source PDF (physical 1-based pages, verified by rendering — bboxes below were read from the PDF text layer, not eyeballed). `gold` is EITHER a region [x1,y1,x2,y2] normalized 0-1000 over the whole page that the returned box CENTER must fall inside (coarse on purpose — catches 'random spot' without needing pixel-perfect labels; some are marked gold_approx), OR the string "NOT_FOUND" when the right behavior is to abstain. Categories: same_page (the part's NAME is printed on this page next to it → VLM should box it), spec_value (a torque/specification VALUE is on the page → box the value; or the page has no such value → abstain), cross_page (the part is on this DIAGRAM page but its name→callout-number mapping lives on ANOTHER page, so the page itself has only the number — single-page grounding is expected to FAIL; probes callout_target/leader_target/context_page test whether the resolved number, an explicit leader-line instruction, or stitching the legend page beside the diagram recover it — measured: none do, it's a VLM leader-line-tracing ceiling), text_trap (the query word appears ONLY as a breadcrumb/heading on this page, not as a groundable component/diagram → abstain, do NOT box the breadcrumb text), absent (the thing is simply not on this page → abstain).
